title: King's Coin Counterfeit Conspiracy, Part 3
description: King's Coin Counterfeit Conspiracy, Part 3 — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Sir Ving N'Seacressy

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Find Colorful Cal the Coin King on Level 5 of the Shadow's Embrace. Afterward, report back to Sir Ving N'Seacressy in the Shadow's Embraces.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Sir Ving N'Seacressy

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: King's Coin Counterfeit Conspiracy, Part 4

Zone: The Shadow's Embrace (Quest)

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Find Colorful Cal the Coin King on Level 5 of the Shadow's Embrace. Afterward, report back to Sir Ving N'Seacressy in the Shadow's Embraces.

Offer:

I appreciate you for indulging my curiousity and interviewing the Token Masters regarding their counterfeit King's Coins. Now, let's see those receipts....

Aha! All of their records indicate that the fake coins are originating from Level 5 in the Shadow's Embrace. Specifically, a fellow named Colorful Cal the Coin King seems to be the primary distribution culpret.

I daresay that if someone were to go and take down Colorful Cal, K.I.C.K.A.S.S.S. would be very grateful. Someone about the same height, weight, and hairstyle as yourself, for example.

Turn-in:

Great job catching Colorful Cal the Coin King in the act! I heard through the grapevine that a K.I.C.K.A.S.S.S. clean-up crew found a bunch of counterfeit coins on ol' Cal. He'll spend a long time in prison now!

Objectives:

  • Take Out Colorful Cal the Coin King

Level range: 47–100
